name: Trace Local Behavior

python_build_lens.purpose: convert public drip_trace_v1 events into Council Minutes and a compact verdict

steps: Open OBSERVATORY.py and choose Human or Agent mode.
Choose the PY, JS, or RS display lens.
Run the explicitly labeled sample replay.
Download or copy the local result only if the human wants it.
privacy: No persistent browser storage is used.
The trace remains in this browser unless a human downloads it.
The checked-in Python lens output is public build data, not live telemetry.
